name: VRM_PRICING_LINES_INTERIM
description: VRM_PRICING_LINES_INTERIM contains source document lines, which are included in the current pricing data validation run.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the application to which the transaction entity belongs. Foreign key to the FND applications table.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document type.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of source document.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of a source document line.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number of a source document.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an inventory item.

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER
columns.description: Inventory item number.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of an inventory item.

columns.name: MEMO_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a memo line.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Code name of the unit of measure.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of a transaction.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price of the source document.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: Unit list price.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Discount percentage of the source document.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price represented in terms of percentage of base price.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit list price represented in terms of percentage of base price.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price that is used to validate VSOE price of a MEA line.

columns.name: LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount of the source document.

columns.name: ITEM_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an item group.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the template.

columns.name: FMV_PRICE_TYPE
columns.description: Fair market value price type. Price type can be either VSOE, TPE, or ESP. Values are from the lookup VRM_FMV_TYPES.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Price basis line validation status.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: The gross margin percentage for a source line.

columns.name: COST_AMOUNT
columns.description: The cost amount of the revenue recognition source line.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies the batch to be processed.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Element is a deliverable or separate unit of accounting. Used to group element types for FMV sets. Values are from the lookup VRM_ELEMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Fulfillment date of a source document line.

columns.name: DELIVERY_STATUS
columns.description: Delivery status of a source document. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_LINE_DELIVERY_STATUS.

columns.name: PARENT_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference key that identifies the parent source document line for the current line.

columns.name: TOP_PARENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the parent is a root node. Y means that the parent in the relationship is at the root node. N means that the parent is not at the root node.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of line sent from the source system. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE. Blank is equivalent to ORA_NEW_LINE.

columns.name: ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Specifies how a new line from the source system should be processed. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION. Blank is equivalent to ORA_ADD_TO_EXISTING_PO.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Specifies message name for warning line.

columns.name: REVISION_INTENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Revision intent for the source document revision line. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_REVISION_INTENT_TYPE.
